paper.title: DocIQ: Document Image Quality Assessment via Vision-Language Models
paper.authors: Zhichao Ma, Fan Huang, Lu Zhao, Fengjun Guo, Guangtao Zhai, Xiongkuo Min

base_document_origin.evidence: Documents were 'curated from publicly accessible PDFs' then 'printed at 300 dpi to create original paper documents'

ori_folder.evidence: Images captured 'using a specified mobile phone' to 'simulate real-world capture conditions'

res_folder.evidence: Enhanced versions of ori/ images using algorithmic methods

distortion_types.evidence: 5 distortion categories x 100 images each = 500 base images

enhancement_methods.note: Both open-source implementations and commercial SDKs used. Paper does not enumerate all 10 specific methods but lists 6 operation categories. Multiple methods per category yield 10 enhanced variants per base image.

annotation_protocol.inter_annotator_agreement: Implemented per ITU-R BT.500, specific values not reported

image_specs.note: Original capture resolution not specified. Images appear to be ~1848x2620 based on metadata

language_distribution.note: Paper does NOT specify language distribution. From OpenLID analysis: ~73% Chinese, ~17% English, ~10% other. From LLM analysis of 500 ori/ images: 76% Chinese, 23% English.

dataset_split.note: Paper says 80-20 split. Actual dataset has train/val/test with counts: train(3850), val(550), test(1100). Val may be carved from train.

schema_field_implications.capture_method: camera_smartphone for ori/, synthetic for res/ - HIGH confidence from paper
schema_field_implications.domain_level1: NOT specified in paper. Must use LLM/visual inspection
schema_field_implications.iso639_language: NOT specified in paper. Must use OpenLID/LLM. Dataset is MULTILINGUAL (zh+en dominant)
schema_field_implications.physical_degradation: 5 explicit categories documented: shadow, occlusion, blur, creases, moire. 100 images each.
schema_field_implications.geometric.orientation: Portrait assumed (documents printed at 300dpi then photographed). Paper does not specify.
schema_field_implications.quality.overall_score: MOS scores available in CSV (1-5 scale, normalize to 0-1)
schema_field_implications.text_content: NOT provided by dataset. Available via Docling GPU OCR extraction.
schema_field_implications.layout_detections: NOT provided by dataset. Available via DocLayout-YOLO and Docling GPU extraction.
schema_field_implications.handwriting_assessment: NOT provided by dataset. LLM enrichment found 103/500 ori/ images with handwriting.
